key_highlights: ASX 200 tumbles as miners and banks sell off amid $100+ oil spike and rising 10-yr Treasury yields (highest since 2023)
RBA flags rental inflation as key concern, complicating rate-cut path
Australia softens local gas supply reservation rules, easing Asian energy fears but drawing political criticism
Iron ore weakness spreads across materials sector, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX
Queensland on brink of credit rating downgrade, raising sovereign risk concerns
Bathla collapse ripples through private credit market, heightening financial sector stress
WA gold exploration surge: multiple high-grade discoveries (Gateway, Golden Dragon, Auric, Kuniko)
High-end property sees steepest price falls while affordable housing remains resilient
Australian dollar weakness looms amid global risk-off tape and rising USD yields
Woolworths breaches 'Price Freeze' on family staples, testing consumer confidence

sectors.trend: Mixed: iron ore weakness spreads (77) pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX, but WA gold exploration activity is robust with multiple high-grade hits (Gateway $45M drill-out, Golden Dragon, Auric 102koz kicker, Kuniko). Flagship ups copper stakes as red metal soars (67). Critical Resources battery tech passes month-long test (40).
sectors.implications: Iron ore drag on major miners offsets junior gold/copper upside. Diversified miners under pressure; small-cap WA gold names offer relative strength. Battery tech validation supports energy transition plays.

sectors.trend: Negative: Banks sell off alongside ASX (31). Bathla collapse ripples across private credit (60). Alleged $600m bank fraud case (38) adds reputational risk. Rising bond yields compress net interest margins.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin pressure from yield volatility. Private credit exposure is a key risk vector. Fraud allegations may trigger regulatory scrutiny.

sectors.trend: Oil at $100–$105 (9, 16, 56) supports upstream producers (WDS.AX, WES.AX, XAR.AX). Australia softens gas reservation rules (39, 53), easing Asian supply fears. Power giant proposes AI data centres at coal plants (65, 66). NSW power adequacy concerns (75).
sectors.implications: High oil benefits LNG and oil producers but raises input costs for downstream. Gas policy shift is a double-edged sword: supports exporters but risks domestic supply security. Data centre energy demand strains grid.

sectors.trend: Woolworths (WOW.AX) breaches Price Freeze on four family staples (1), testing brand trust. Macy's turnaround positive (20) but Primark online pivot vs ABF decline (8) signals retail fragmentation. Consumer price sensitivity elevated.
sectors.implications: WOW.AX and WES.AX face margin pressure from input costs vs. pricing power limits. Consumer staples remain defensive but growth is constrained.

sectors.trend: High-end property sees steepest falls while affordable segment resilient (61). Home sales drop as mortgage rates hit 1-year high (13). NSW budget faces stamp duty hit (54). RBA rental inflation concern (15). Property chiefs call for more migrants (45).
sectors.implications: Residential REITs (e.g., GPT.AX, ICPS.AX) face rental yield pressure. Commercial REITs may benefit from data centre demand. Housing supply gap persists.

sectors.trend: AI infrastructure plays attract fund inflows (6, 12). Palantir-Nvidia sovereign AI pact (11). Crypto mining stocks fall harder than BTC on risk-off (5). Power giant seeks AI data centre tenants at coal sites (65).
sectors.implications: Limited direct ASX exposure but energy demand from data centres benefits utilities. Crypto mining weakness is a global risk-off signal.

key_themes: Global risk-off: $100 oil + rising yields drive broad equity sell-off
RBA policy dilemma: rental inflation vs. growth slowdown
Commodity divergence: iron ore weak, gold/copper strong, oil elevated
Australian gas policy shift and energy security debate
Housing market bifurcation: luxury falls, affordable resilient
Private credit stress (Bathla) as emerging systemic risk
AUD weakness risk amid USD strength and global yield spike

risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge with energy exposure (WDS.AX, XAR.AX); reduce duration in rate-sensitive sectors

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA constrained by rental inflation, delaying rate cuts
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour dividend-paying value over growth; monitor RBA statements for guidance

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore demand weakness spreading (China inflation soars)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce BHP.AX/RIO.AX/FMG.AX weightings; rotate into gold and copper juniors

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Queensland credit downgrade and sovereign risk
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid QLD-linked infrastructure and REIT exposure; monitor S&P/Moody's

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Private credit contagion from Bathla collapse
risk_assessment.mitigation: Review bank private credit exposures; favour large-cap diversified banks
Hedge AUD exposure; favour export-oriented miners with USD revenue

opportunities.rationale: Multiple high-grade hits (Gateway, Golden Dragon, Auric, Kuniko) signal a WA gold super-cycle; gold benefits from risk-off and yield spike
Sustained $100–$105 oil supports upstream margins; gas policy shift supports LNG exporters

opportunities.rationale: Flagship copper stake increase and Critical Resources battery validation support energy transition theme
M&A event provides near-term upside for ALU.AX holders

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim residential REIT and high-end property exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Steepest price falls at luxury end; rising mortgage rates suppress sales; NSW stamp duty hit

defensive_moves.rationale: AUD shocker risk with global yield spike; RBA unlikely to cut soon given rental inflation

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid QLD-linked sovereign and infrastructure credit
defensive_moves.rationale: Credit downgrade risk elevates default probability and spreads

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 likely to remain under pressure over 1–3 months. $100+ oil and rising global yields cap equity multiples. RBA on hold due to rental inflation. Iron ore weakness drags materials. Offsets: WA gold juniors, energy names, and M&A catalysts (Austal). Expect volatility with downside bias unless oil normalises.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if oil stabilises and RBA pivots. Structural themes: WA gold/copper exploration, battery tech, AI data centre energy demand, and gas export policy support. Housing bifurcation continues. Key risk: prolonged global yield spike or Chinese demand deterioration.
